sections.text:
-Target: all enemies. Ability Power 180. Success value 100. 3x physical damage (Fire).
Ability Power boosted by 10 for each increase in Skill level.
-Target: all allies. Recovers 60% of max HP.
-Target: all allies excluding yourself. Increases ATK and MATK by 50% for 60 seconds.
-Target: all enemies. Applies Scorching for 30 seconds with a success value of 70.
-Removes Slumber from all allies.
-Target: yourself. Applies Rage for 60 seconds (increases max HP, ATK, and MATK by 100%; nullifies status ailments and Cost reduction. When in effect, recovers 30% of your character's max HP, recovers 30 Cost, and removes debuffs/special debuffs when you defeat an enemy).
Reduces Wind Unison Attack and Great Spirit Unison Attack damage by 30% when equipped in the main slot.
